steps.prompt: Before the check: which geometry fact do you reach for first, and which one do you still look up?

cards.title: Angles and right triangles: quick review
cards.body: Triangle angles add to $180^\circ$; an exterior angle is the sum of the far two; co-interior angles add to $180^\circ$. Pythagoras $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$; triples $3, 4, 5$ and $5, 12, 13$; $x, x, x\sqrt{2}$ and $x, x\sqrt{3}, 2x$.

cards.title: Similarity, area and polygons: quick review
cards.body: Similar: sides in one ratio $k$, areas $k^2$; altitude to the hypotenuse $h^2 = pq$. Area $\frac{1}{2}bh$ or Heron. Angle sum $180(n - 2)$, exterior angles $360$, diagonals $\frac{n(n - 3)}{2}$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
